value.rationale: The physically motivated sampling-distance problem targets source size composition while treating absolute source strength as unknown. The exact unique optimum and three-regime rare-particle scaling resolve when the most informative sensor escapes arbitrarily far downstream; this nontrivial 2:1 phase boundary gives concrete design guidance not implied by generic numerical D-optimal solvers.
